name: OpenFIGI
tagline: Bloomberg FIGI security identifier mapping for financial instruments
description: OpenFIGI provides free and paid API access to map financial security identifiers (tickers, CUSIP, ISIN, SEDOL, etc.) to Bloomberg FIGIs, used widely in regulatory reporting and market data integration. Endpoints support single/batch mapping, search, and filter queries against a global instrument universe.

auth.details: Optional API key via X-OPENFIGI-APIKEY header for higher rate limits; self-serve signup. Unauthenticated requests allowed at lower limits.

use_cases: map a ticker or ISIN to Bloomberg FIGI for regulatory reporting
search financial instruments by name or symbol
normalize security identifiers across market data feeds
